endpoints.name: Attachment
endpoints.description: One attachment by id.

endpoints.name: Attachments
endpoints.description: The files attached to one sheet. Requires a sheet id. Metadata; the binary is a separate fetch.

endpoints.name: Discussion Attachments
endpoints.description: The files attached to one discussion. Requires the sheet and discussion ids.

endpoints.name: Row Attachments
endpoints.description: The files attached to one row. Requires the sheet and row ids.

endpoints.name: Versions
endpoints.description: The version history of one attachment. Requires the sheet and attachment ids.

endpoints.name: Automation Rule
endpoints.description: One automation rule by id.

endpoints.name: Automation Rules
endpoints.description: The automation rules on one sheet -- alerts, reminders, approval requests and update requests, with their conditions and recipients. Requires a sheet id. Automation changes cells without a person doing it, so this explains edits with no obvious author.

endpoints.name: Cell History
endpoints.description: Every past value of ONE CELL, with who changed it and when. Requires the sheet, row and column ids. The only audit trail Smartsheet offers at cell level -- a sheet holds current values only, so when a date slipped or a status changed is answerable here and nowhere else, at the cost of one request per cell.

endpoints.name: Column
endpoints.description: One column by id. Requires the sheet id.

endpoints.name: Columns
endpoints.description: The column definitions of one sheet, with title, type, index, whether it is the primary column, and for picklists the allowed options. Requires a sheet id. THE SCHEMA: every cell references a columnId, so this is the decoder without which sheet data is a set of numbers against opaque ids.

endpoints.name: Comment
endpoints.description: One comment by id. Requires the sheet id.

endpoints.name: Contact
endpoints.description: One contact by id.

endpoints.name: Contacts
endpoints.description: The contacts available to the caller for assignment and sharing. Smartsheet contact-type cells reference these, so it is the decoder for a contact column.

endpoints.name: Cross-sheet Reference
endpoints.description: One cross-sheet reference by id.

endpoints.name: Cross-sheet References
endpoints.description: The references one sheet makes to ranges in other sheets. Requires a sheet id. THE DEPENDENCY GRAPH: a formula pulling from another sheet is invisible in the cell values, so this is what reveals that a number is driven by a sheet somewhere else.

endpoints.name: Discussions
endpoints.description: The comment threads on one sheet. Requires a sheet id. Where the reasoning behind a change is recorded, which the cells do not carry.

endpoints.name: Discussion
endpoints.description: One discussion by id, with its comments.

endpoints.name: Row Discussions
endpoints.description: The comment threads attached to one row. Requires the sheet and row ids.

endpoints.name: Favorites
endpoints.description: The items the caller has starred. Scoped to the caller.

endpoints.name: Folder
endpoints.description: One folder by id, with its sheets, reports, dashboards and subfolders.

endpoints.name: Sheet Folders
endpoints.description: The folders in the caller's home area.

endpoints.name: Subfolders
endpoints.description: The folders inside one folder. Requires a folder id. Folders nest, so a full tree means walking this repeatedly.

endpoints.name: Workspace Folders
endpoints.description: The folders inside one workspace. Requires a workspace id.

endpoints.name: Group
endpoints.description: One group by id, with its members.

endpoints.name: Organization Groups
endpoints.description: The groups in the organisation, used to share items in bulk.

endpoints.name: Contents
endpoints.description: Everything in the caller's home -- sheets, folders, reports, dashboards, workspaces and templates in one response. The fastest inventory of what a user can reach, and the alternative to walking folders one at a time.

endpoints.name: Report
endpoints.description: One report by id, with its rows. Requires a report id. Returns data drawn from several sheets, so rows carry a sheet reference the source sheets do not need.

endpoints.name: Reports
endpoints.description: The reports defined, with name and timestamps. A Smartsheet report is a saved query across sheets, so it is the closest thing to a cross-sheet view -- and its definition states which sheets the organisation considers related.

endpoints.name: Report Publish Status
endpoints.description: Whether one report is published to the web. Requires a report id.

endpoints.name: Row
endpoints.description: One row by id, with its cells. Requires the sheet id. Includes optional attachments, discussions and column formulas.

endpoints.name: Search Everything
endpoints.description: Searches across every object the caller can access -- sheet names, cell contents, discussions, attachments. The route to finding a value when the sheet holding it is unknown, which the per-sheet endpoints cannot answer.

endpoints.name: Search Sheet
endpoints.description: Searches within one sheet. Requires the sheet id and a query.

endpoints.name: Server Info
endpoints.description: The Smartsheet server's supported locales, formats and feature set. Notably it lists the FORMAT TABLES -- the numeric codes cells use for fonts, colours and number formats -- which are otherwise uninterpretable.

endpoints.name: Report Share
endpoints.description: One report share by id.

endpoints.name: Report Shares
endpoints.description: Who one report is shared with and at what access level. Requires a report id.

endpoints.name: Sheet Share
endpoints.description: One sheet share by id.

endpoints.name: Sheet Shares
endpoints.description: Who one sheet is shared with and at what access level. Requires a sheet id. The access list, and the reason two users see different sheets.

endpoints.name: Sheet Version
endpoints.description: The current version number of one sheet. Requires a sheet id. A cheap change check: the version increments on every edit, so polling this is far cheaper than refetching the sheet to see whether anything moved.

endpoints.name: Sheet
endpoints.suffix: /2.0/sheets/{Sheet ID}?include={Include?:attachments,crossSheetReferences...}&exclude={Exclude?:filteredOutRows,linkInFromCellDetails...}&columnIds={Column IDs?:value1,value2...}&filterId={Filter ID?}&ifVersionAfter={If Version After?:version}&level={Level?}&rowIds={Row IDs?:value1,value2...}&rowNumbers={Row Numbers?:value1,value2...}&rowsModifiedSince={Rows Modified Since?:YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ}
endpoints.description: One sheet by id, WITH its rows and cells. Requires a sheet id. The main data endpoint. Cells reference their column by columnId rather than by name, so a row is unreadable without the column list -- and a cell carries both a raw value and a displayValue, which differ for dates, contacts and formulas.

endpoints.name: Organization Sheets
endpoints.description: Every sheet in the organisation, not just those the caller can access. Administrator only. The inventory view, and the way to find sheets nobody is watching.

endpoints.name: Sheets
endpoints.description: The sheets the user can access, with name, permalink, createdAt and modifiedAt. THE STARTING POINT, and the shape of Smartsheet is worth stating once: a sheet is a user-built grid, so its COLUMNS ARE DEFINED PER SHEET and nothing about the data is knowable in advance -- Columns is the schema and must be read before any row makes sense. The listing carries no cell data at all.

endpoints.name: Sheet Publish Status
endpoints.description: Whether one sheet is published to the web, and in what form. Requires a sheet id. A published sheet is readable without credentials, which makes this a security-review endpoint as much as a configuration one.

endpoints.name: Sheet Summary
endpoints.description: The summary fields of one sheet -- the named values that sit beside the grid rather than in it. Requires a sheet id. Where a sheet records totals, owners and status that are properties of the whole sheet rather than of any row.

endpoints.name: Summary Fields
endpoints.description: The individual summary fields with their values and formats. Requires a sheet id. The row-shaped view of the same data.

endpoints.name: Sight
endpoints.description: One dashboard by id, with its widgets and their sources. The map from a dashboard tile back to the sheet feeding it.

endpoints.name: Sights
endpoints.description: The dashboards defined, with name and timestamps. Sights are Smartsheet's dashboards, assembled from widgets over sheets and reports.

endpoints.name: Sight Publish Status
endpoints.description: Whether one dashboard is published to the web. Requires a sight id.

endpoints.name: Public Templates
endpoints.description: The templates Smartsheet publishes. Reference content, identical on every account.

endpoints.name: User-created Templates
endpoints.description: The templates the account has created.

endpoints.name: Update Request
endpoints.description: One update request by id.

endpoints.name: Update Requests
endpoints.description: The pending requests asking someone to fill in rows. Requires a sheet id. Outstanding data collection, which no cell value reveals.

endpoints.name: Sent Update Request
endpoints.description: One sent update request by id.

endpoints.name: Sent Update Requests
endpoints.description: Update requests already sent, with their status. Requires a sheet id. The record of who was asked and whether they responded.

endpoints.name: Current User
endpoints.description: The account the credentials belong to, optionally with its groups. One record, and the explanation for which sheets the rest of this connector can see.

endpoints.name: User
endpoints.description: One user by id.

endpoints.name: Users
endpoints.description: The users in the account, with email, name, admin and licensed flags, and their status. Filterable by email; lastLogin is available only when explicitly included. THE LICENSED FLAG IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS COMMERCIALLY -- Smartsheet bills on licensed users, and unlicensed collaborators are free, so a headcount and a bill do not correspond.

endpoints.name: Workspace
endpoints.description: One workspace by id, optionally loading its whole contents. Requires a workspace id.

endpoints.name: Workspaces
endpoints.description: The workspaces, each grouping sheets, reports, dashboards and templates with shared permissions. The organisational container above folders.
